caseName: LOUISIANA Ex Rel. WASHINGTON v. WALKER, WARDEN
caseNameFull: State of Louisiana Ex Rel. Steve Washington v. v. G. Walker
attorneys: Robert H. Reiter and Jack N. Rogers for appellant., Jack P. F. Gremillion, Attorney General of Louisiana, and Scallan E. Walsh, Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Frankfurter took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
